options.name: algorithm
options.description: Encryption algorithm for master key or tablespace encryption AES256 is the default and recommended algorithm 3DES168, GOST256, SEED128 are desupported in Oracle 26ai

options.name: export_file
options.description: File path for key export/import operations

options.name: export_secret
options.description: Secret passphrase for key export/import file encryption

options.name: file_name_convert
options.description: Dictionary mapping old datafile names to new names for online conversion Example: {'old_file.dbf': 'new_file.dbf'}

options.name: force_keystore
options.description: Use FORCE KEYSTORE clause (temporarily opens auto-login keystore)

options.name: key_tag
options.description: User-defined tag for the master encryption key

options.name: keystore_password
options.description: Password for the keystore (required for most operations)

options.name: master_key_action
options.description: Action to perform on master encryption key

options.name: online
options.description: Whether to perform online (true) or offline (false) tablespace conversion

options.name: tablespace
options.description: Name of the tablespace to encrypt, decrypt, or rekey

options.name: tablespace_encryption_policy
options.description: Database-level tablespace encryption policy parameter AUTO_ENABLE encrypts all new tablespaces automatically MANUAL_ENABLE requires explicit ENCRYPTION clause in CREATE TABLESPACE DECRYPT_ONLY allows decryption but prevents new encryption

options.name: tablespace_state
options.description: Desired encryption state of the tablespace
